title: SMOK IPX 80 Replacement Pod
description:
Description
Specifications
Sold individually. Please adjust the order number to the desired amount.
There are two types of IPX80 pods: IPX RPM Pods and IPX RPM 2 Pods, which are compatible with the coils from the RPM series and RPM 2 series.
Accessory Quick Links:
SMOK RPM Replacement Coils
SMOK RPM2 Replacement Coils
Pod Capacity: 5.5ml
Duck-Billed Mouthpiece
Transparent E-Juice Window
Compatible with the Smok IPX80 kit
